771420103.text: #Uh-oh, they've spotted us, {NICKNAME}! Time to scoot!

771420104.text: They're closing in from both sides! What do we do...

771420106.text: Bloody hell! That blonde's got up to the train car roof!

771420107.text: Stinkin' human thieves. "Young Sire" was right. Humans are a shameless race, just like the Luchkin lot.

771420108.text: Nowhere to run now, little crook! Time to die!

771420110.text: Laying your hands on "Young Sire"'s goods... How dare you!

771420201.text: You're over the line, Cecile. This isn't your business.

771420203.text: Luchkin territory, Luchkin rules. We'll be the ones managing this.

771420204.text: Have you forgotten the rules we follow? It's there in black and white: "No harm to families, no abuse of the women and children." Or do you Ismaylovs not remember that nowadays?

771420205.text: And you're gonna stop us, then?

771420207.text: Looks like two groups have gotten into a disagreement.

771420208.text: One more time, Cecile. One more time I'll tell you. Keep your noses out of this. The "Old Sire" also said this: "Debts are to be repaid. Always!"

771420209.text: Please... Just give us a few days. Just a few more days! You've already taken Papa to the lumberyard to pay back the debt... and Mama can't work due to injury.

771420210.text: It's just Grandma and me at home now... I... I didn't mean not to pay! Grandma and I... We're selling dolls to help with Papa's debt!

771420211.text: Soon... Very soon. We can make seven dolls a day. We just need four, no, three more days! Please. Three more days, and we can pay back what we owe for this month!

771420212.text: Three days, huh... That's what the last guy told us. And guess what? We caught him that same night, in the underground gambling dens.

771420213.text: No one who owes a debt ever thinks about how they got there in the first place, eh... Let me tell you something, girl. You break trust, and you find yourself slipping down the slope to becoming trash, you hear?

771420214.text: *sob* ...But you were the ones who came early...

771420215.text: Hey! What do you think you're doing, bullying a little girl like that?

771420218.text: And what hole did you two crawl out from, huh? First Luchkins, and now some blond "ally of justice" and a Vila kid...

771420219.text: If I knew this job was gonna be this tiring, I'd have swapped with that bugger Lorie.

771420220.text: Enough. You bloody debtors are always repeating the same old sob story. I'm done listening to that drivel.

771420221.text: You really want to stick your neck out for this lass? Don't you forget the shape we beat you into last time... Hehaha...

771420223.text: But if that's what you want... You know the rules. Draw your sword!

771420224.text: I... Even if I get beaten, I won't...

subQuests.subQuestName: Duke it out with the gang members

771420301.text: Heh... Show me what you've got!

771420307.text: Looks like your bite's not as good as your bark...

771420401.text: Gah... Where'd they find you, anyway... You've got good moves...

771420403.text: I know. A loss is a loss. I'll give you two days. We'll be back then.

771420404.text: And if you think you can escape, girl, you've got another thing coming!

771420406.text: It's okay, Marfa. It'll be alright, I promise...

771420407.text: Ah, right, and thank you for the help, you two! If you hadn't stepped in, I'm not sure if I could've gotten out of this one in one piece...

771420408.text: I'm Cecile, and I'm with the Luchkins. What are yours?

771420410.text: I... well. I'm Marfa. Thank you so much!

771420411.text: Oh, it was alright. Also, who was that guy anyway? Y'know, that Linde-something guy...

771420412.text: He's Papa's creditor. Papa owes them tons of money because of his gambling habit. They even took him away...

771420415.text: One of the gangs in Snezhnaya. They're the biggest, but they're also the most rotten lot.

771420416.text: Their leader, the Young Sire... has been making some real moves lately.

771420417.text: The gang's appetite for Mora's gone up by leaps and bounds, and they've even started harassing women and kids for money...

771420419.text: Ah! I almost forgot to introduce myself. Greetings. I am Sofya Pavlovna Zaitseva, a fae of the Luchkin, one who stands for justice.

771420420.text: #You're as skilled as the legends say, {NICKNAME}.

771420421.text: I see I'm famous around these parts...

771420422.text: The "outland traveler"... We've all heard something or another about you by now.

771420423.text: Well, the Ismaylovs are targeting more people like Marfa, and those people have come to us Luchkins for help... but their numbers are as an endless stream...

771420424.text: We carry righteousness in our hearts...

771420425.text: But righteousness will not pay their debts...

771420426.text: Well, indeed, justice is rarely worth much Mora.

771420427.text: I—It's fine. If they show up in two days, Grandma and I... We'll have the money to pay up!

771420428.text: This time, sure, but what about next time? The interest on Mora borrowed compounds, and you can barely pay that interest as-is...

771420430.text: Whoa, those Ismaylov guys are horrible!

771420431.text: Many Snezhnayan gangs were founded to protect the people... but the Ismaylovs' have broken with the "rules" as they were first laid down.

771420432.text: They've become blood-sucking insects perched on the bodies of the citizenry...

771420433.text: It's just a shame that we lack the strength to challenge them. If not, I'm sure we would put a stop to their abuses...

771420434.text: #C'mon, {NICKNAME}. These guys are beyond awful! Let's help!

771420436.text: If you'd be willing to help, we're prepared to provide some compensation...

771420438.text: Of course, when I say "some," I do in fact mean... "satisfactory."

771420440.text: Alright, alright, if you're compensating us...

771420447.text: Alright. In that case, please come with me. I suspect our leader would have to have some words with you.

771420449.text: Yes. I have a feeling that Mr. Zmei will be happy to see you.

771420450.text: The fae once ruled Snezhnaya, and most in our gang are also fae... but since the Tsaritsa took the throne, humans have been held higher in her favor...

771420451.text: Mr. Zmei, being human, has an easier time communicating with those in power than we do...

771420452.text: I'll bet he's mulling over what to do about the Izmaylovs as we speak. Anyway, come with me!

771420443.text: ...Your swordsmanship is first-rate, as is your courage. With your help, our chances of stopping the Ismaylovs have increased.

771420444.text: But don't worry, we won't ask you to help for nothing. We have our rules, and they say that those who help us will not leave empty-handed.

771420445.text: Heh, so we'll be helping out and getting paid for it!

771420501.text: Hey, Evgenyi. Wanna get some drinks later at night?

771420502.text: Don't remind me... I've got work to do at night. Maybe things will get better in a bit...

771420503.text: What's your job anyway? Seriously, it's been ages since we've been to Kvasnik!

771420504.text: I mean, it's not like you don't know... Lately, the gang's been... *sigh*

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the leader of the Luchkins

771420601.text: Ah, Sofya, you're back... How did things go with Marfa?

771420602.text: #Things went fine... thanks to these two. Zmei, this is {NICKNAME}, and this is Paimon.

771420603.text: Ah, so you're the rumored... On behalf of Marfa and all in Snezhnograd who suffer under the Ismaylovs' boot, I thank you both.

771420605.text: My name is Zmei Luchkin. I... guide the Luchkin on their path.

771420609.text: Haha, well, that's Iryna for you. She's the one who enforces the "rules" here, and has done so long enough that she might appear... a little hard. But I assure you, she's as warm-hearted as they come!

771420610.text: Iryna's workload has grown heavier ever since the Old Sire passed, and that's weighed her mood down lately...

771420611.text: And recently, there's been this ugly business with the Izmaylovs...

771420612.text: #Ah, right. I was just going to mention that. {NICKNAME} and Paimon have agreed to help us teach those louts a lesson...

771420613.text: Oh? Well, that's... the best news I've heard of late, I must say! Is it true? Will the two of you help?

771420616.text: Haha, no one told me you were such a funny person... That said, though, we cannot settle the Izmaylov affair with courage alone.

771420617.text: Let's see, where should I begin... Ah, yes. With the debt collection, I suppose. They've been collecting across a vast area recently, regardless of whether the debtors can pay up or not.

771420619.text: This isn't something that a gang would normally do. Do this often enough, and no one will ever borrow money from you again. Even so, the Izmaylovs are doing it...

771420620.text: That's... Uh, that's gotta mean that they need tons of Mora!

771420621.text: Precisely, Miss Paimon! They need tons of Mora, and my sources tell me they've been using this Mora to rent many a train carriage...

771420622.text: To pay for a trip, maybe?

771420624.text: Ahaha! I'm afraid that renting cars for trips doesn't cost that much... Instead, I imagine they're using the Snezhnayan rail system to move some goods in secret...

771420625.text: That's generally how the world works. If you do things in the open, then you'll more or less pay fair prices. But if you do something in secret, it'll cost you extra.

771420627.text: They're moving raw materials that could very well be used to construct a device that can open a Shadow Realm...

771420630.text: #...It's fine, Iryna. If... If we're serious about asking for {NICKNAME}'s help, we should lay our cards on the table.

771420631.text: It's as Sofya says... Izmaylov's Young Sire is finding a way to open a gate to the Shadow Realm...

771420632.text: The Shadow Realm... Hmm, you're talking about that weird space that we entered along with Alyosha back then...

771420633.text: Ah, I see you've already entered one such Realm. Well, I'll be frank, everything related to these Shadow Realms is dangerous, whether it's the Realms themselves or the things within them...

771420634.text: The Old Sire once prohibited any of us from touching that business. As the "rules" had it, such matters were to be left to the Druzhna and the Energy Commission.

771420635.text: If the Young Sire does intend to do something related to them, we'll have to move fast to stop him before he succeeds.

771420636.text: So, the order of the day is to identify the cargo they're carrying... which we'll have to trouble the two of you to do.

771420701.text: Hey, you there. Have tonight's goods arrived?

771420703.text: Hmph. The Young Sire will have your head on a pike if anything goes wrong — assuming I don't gut you first.

771420704.text: I'm watching it personally! Everything will be fine, sir, so please! Please be at ease.

771420705.text: There he is! That's our guy, Lorie!

771420707.text: You'll have to stick close to find the train they're using... But take care not to be discovered. Best case scenario? You grab the sample before the train departs.

771420801.text: Finished checking the goods, Kirov? Meselson, go to the back and get Ishogu to swap with you. Good work out there these past few days.

771420803.text: Ishogu? Where's that guy gone off to... You two get some rest first, I'll go bring him back here!

771420804.text: #Looks like they're changing shifts. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, this might be our chance to sneak in!

771420905.text: Hurry it up! If tonight's stock only gets there tomorrow, The Butcher's gonna show us where he got the name.

771420906.text: To the station, quick! And get those goods loaded up to the freight carriage in the back...

771420932.text: That's true. There are too many people over here, and we might lose our guy. Hmm, the station's got a second floor. Let's go up and see...

771420933.text: Heh, we really can see the whole station from here... Hmm, where's that Lorie guy gone off to...

771420934.text: Look, over there! He's boarded that train. That's the one we're looking for!

771420935.text: Looks like we can jump from here over to that train. Let's go!

771421201.text: Here at last... This has got to be the cargo they're moving...

771421203.text: Can we... get a sample from these boxes?

771421205.text: But Paimon's hands are shorter. You do it! Paimon will keep watch!

771421208.text: Dear passengers, the train you have boarded is about to depart... Please remain in your seats, and be careful of tremors when the train starts...

771421209.text: Hurry, the train's about to depart!

771421211.text: Nice! Now we need to get off the train... Huh?

771421212.text: You feel your center of gravity shift slightly. Then, the view outside the window slowly moves backward...\nThe train is on the move.

771421207.text: Alright. Paimon will keep watch! Don't get stuck, now!

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to escape the train car

771421301.text: Well, we've got the sample, and this bad guy is down... But how are we going to get off the train now...

771421304.text: What's that? W—Wait, is that a sled?

771421307.text: After them! After them! Up, up, you runts! Don't let 'em leave with the stuff!

771421309.text: Did you get on? Are you alright?

771421312.text: Phew! That's good. I wouldn't be able to explain myself to Zmei if something happened to you!

771421315.text: Phew. Honestly, Paimon was scared stiff when the train started moving. She didn't know if you'd be able to pick us up...

771421316.text: The moment I saw that the train was moving and you hadn't gotten off, I started giving chase using the sled!

771421317.text: Good work prepping that sled, Sofya.

771421318.text: Well, uh... I borrowed it last-minute from a kind gentleman at the station...

771421319.text: #Well, it's good that this nice guy was there! Otherwise, Paimon and {NICKNAME} might not have gotten out at all!

771421320.text: Haha, well, I suppose we should go thank that gentleman later, huh?

771421323.text: Great! Alright, let's go. Zmei's waiting for us!

771421314.text: Pssh, what are you saying? Your leg's just fine!

771421001.text: No unauthorized entry beyond this point. Go back to your seat.

771422101.text: Ah. Do you... still have questions?

771422103.text: Before he passed from illness, the Old Sire was the chairman of the High Table, an organization comprising various gang leaders... Or at least, that was what he was to the gangs.

771422104.text: But to Iryna, Remusov, myself, and the Young Sire... He was something far more important...

771422106.text: We were all children he picked up from various places. He raised us, gave us surnames, and then... he placed these organizations into our hands...

771422113.text: Fair enough. I hope your operation goes smoothly.

771423001.text: Iryna... You must have had the same hunch I did... The Old Sire was not felled by illness... His death almost certainly has something to do with the Young Sire...

771423002.text: Yes... That is something that he would do...

771423003.text: And if that is the case, he has gone too far...

771423004.text: Perhaps he began to hate the name "Nikolayevich" well before we did.

771423005.text: I never hated that name, Iryna. Never.

771429904.text: Heh. You're pretty good. Tell you what, a bet's a bet. I'll give this kid three days. Let's go!
